versions.content: For each received T ime S ynchronization message the FrTSyn shall validate the message as follows (all conditions must match): 1. Type matches depending on the FrTSynRxCrcValidated parameter 2. SC value is within the accepted range (refer t o [SWS_FrTSyn_00048] and [SWS_FrTSyn_00049] ) 3. D matches to the defined Time Domain range for each Type 4. D matches to one of the configured Time Domains 5. SyncTimeNSec (SYNC message ) or OfsTimeNSec (OFS message ) matches the defined range of StbM_TimeStampType.nanoseconds . 6. CRC (including DataID ) matches depending on the FrTSynRxCrcValidated parameter .
